key_ai_features: Trip.Planner (labeled NEW) — structured AI map planner
standout_feature: Trip.Planner with map-integrated AI workflow + TripGenie Q&A
biggest_gap: TripGenie is Q&A, not conversational planning — less creative than Mindtrip
biggest_advantage_over_mindtrip: Native booking across flights, hotels, trains, cars, activities + full loyalty program

executive_recommendation.description: A named AI assistant on Saudia.com and the app, scoped to Saudia-exclusive knowledge: Hajj visa process, Alfursan point redemption, fare rules, lounge access, connection intelligence — questions no OTA can answer.
executive_recommendation.why_it_matters: Trip.com's TripGenie demonstrates that an AI layer on a transactional platform reduces friction, improves discovery, and builds brand trust without disrupting the booking engine. Saudia's exclusive knowledge of Islamic travel, Alfursan loyalty, and Saudi routes creates an AI that OTAs literally cannot replicate.
executive_recommendation.business_impact: Reduces call center volume on repeatable queries; improves conversion on complex Hajj/Umrah itineraries where travelers have many questions; creates a proprietary AI personality that no OTA can match on Saudi travel knowledge.
